name: e- plus pi+
description: One e- and one pi+ per event from a single vertex. The e- kinetic energy is uniform in [100, 2000] MeV (no sub-100 MeV electrons, so that both particles are visible), the pi+ kinetic energy uniform in [200, 2000] MeV; each has its own isotropic direction. Fixed two-entry particles list: both particles are in every event.
